tokens.TITLE: 5a1ive: The Custom G-Shock Designer From Toronto
tokens.META_DESCRIPTION: 5a1ive is the Toronto designer behind 55555stuff — one-of-one crystal-augmented G-Shocks and wire-wrapped luxury eyewear worn across the rap scene.
tokens.KEYWORDS: 5a1ive, 5a1ive G-Shock, 55555stuff, custom G-Shock, crystal G-Shock, CasiOak custom, Dylan 5a1ive, Toronto designer, custom eyewear, DGTL Influence, creator profile
tokens.DEK: The Toronto designer behind 55555stuff hand-sets crystals onto G-Shocks and luxury frames — one-of-one pieces that have reached Yung Fazo, the Toronto Raptors, and Drake's Iceman launch, a 2026 campaign he worked on with DGTL.
tokens.HERO_CAPTION: A wall of 5a1ive custom crystal G-Shocks from the 55555stuff collection. Courtesy @5a1ive / 55555stuff.com.
tokens.STAT_FOOTNOTE: @5a1ive is a verified account with 16.2K followers and 161 posts as of July 17, 2026. Iceman-campaign involvement per DGTL, which co-managed the project; the album's Toronto rollout is widely reported. Product details from 55555stuff.com.
tokens.LEAD: 5a1ive doesn't decorate watches — he rebuilds them. Working out of Toronto under the label 55555stuff, the designer buries G-Shock cases under hand-set crystals and raw mineral clusters, turning a stock Casio into a one-of-one object that reads more like jewellery than a watch.
tokens.BODY_1: The signature is excess with control. An amethyst geode erupts off the bezel of a DW-6900; a GA-2100 CasiOak disappears under a field of tightly-packed stones; a red build made for the Toronto Raptors glitters like a championship ring. Every piece starts from a customer's colour and a loose brief, then 5a1ive takes full creative control — no two builds are the same, and that's the entire pitch.
tokens.H2_1: A craft nobody else is doing at this level
tokens.BODY_2: Most custom G-Shock sellers swap a bezel or add a bracelet. 5a1ive treats the watch as raw canvas — cutting, setting and sculpting until the Casio underneath is barely visible. The same hand shows up on the 55555stuff eyewear line, where Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel and Burberry frames are wrapped in aluminum wire and crystal for what the brand calls the nightlife scene. It reads as one coherent language: industrial hardware, softened and iced until it looks expensive and a little dangerous.
tokens.PULLQUOTE: A stock Casio goes in. A one-of-one comes out.
tokens.H2_2: From a Shopify store to the rap scene's wrists
tokens.BODY_3: The work travels because the right people wear it. 5a1ive pieces have shown up on Yung Fazo, Osamason, Xavier Trudeau, Slayr and Rio, and the brand's gallery documents a red-crystal build worn by the Toronto Raptors. In 2026 that reach hit a new ceiling: as part of Drake's Iceman launch — a Toronto-wide rollout 5a1ive worked on with DGTL — the studio produced custom G-Shocks tied to Drake's world, including pieces for Drake and his son Adonis (per DGTL). The verified @5a1ive account turns each build into a viral clip, from "testing Drake fans" to flying a piece to Bloody Osiris in Paris. The full catalogue lives at 55555stuff.com.
tokens.CALLOUT_1: Every G-Shock is one-of-one — customer colour in, full creative control out.
tokens.CALLOUT_2: Raw crystal clusters and dense stone-setting, not off-the-shelf bezels.
tokens.CALLOUT_3: A matching eyewear line: Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel and Burberry, wire-wrapped and iced.
tokens.CALLOUT_4: Reach from the rap scene to the Raptors to Drake's Iceman launch.
tokens.BODY_4: For a brand chasing the rage-and-nightlife audience, 5a1ive is the rare partner whose product is already the marketing — a physical object people photograph, wear and want. That's the profile DGTL Influence looks for: a maker with a look nobody can copy and a scene that carries it for free.
tokens.STATCALLOUT_CAP: One-of-one, every time. A customer picks a base colour; 5a1ive conceptualises and hand-builds the rest. No two pieces are identical — by design.

tokens.FAQ_A1: 5a1ive is a Toronto-based designer and the maker behind 55555stuff, known for one-of-one custom G-Shock watches encrusted with hand-set crystals and raw mineral clusters, plus a line of wire-wrapped luxury eyewear.
tokens.FAQ_A2: 55555stuff (55555stuff.com) is 5a1ive's label, selling custom crystal G-Shocks from about $500 USD and augmented Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel and Burberry eyewear. Every watch is a one-of-one commission.
tokens.FAQ_Q3: How much is a custom 5a1ive G-Shock?
tokens.FAQ_A3: Custom G-Shocks start around $500 USD and run to roughly $600 for models like the Bey Blade build. Each is handmade to order with a 2–3 week lead time.
tokens.FAQ_A4: 5a1ive pieces have appeared on Yung Fazo, Osamason, Xavier Trudeau, Slayr and Rio, and on the Toronto Raptors. In 2026, 5a1ive also produced custom G-Shocks for Drake's Iceman launch — including pieces for Drake and his son Adonis — on a project co-managed with DGTL.
